lines.zh: 我走在雷声前面，雨还没到。
lines.en: I walk ahead of the thunder; rain has not come.

lines.zh: 我的脚踩过湿草，没有声音。
lines.en: My feet cross wet grass without a sound.

lines.zh: 三叉戟拖在地上，划出沟。
lines.en: The trident drags and cuts a furrow.
I take one step at a time, waiting for the clouds.
My bones rattle beneath my skin.
Rain runs down my face.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都伏下去。
lines.en: The grass lies flat where I have walked.

lines.zh: 我不赶路，云会自己压下来。
lines.en: I do not hurry; the clouds come down themselves.
I shift the trident to my left hand.
Sparks jump between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我踩着水洼走，水面发亮。
lines.en: I walk through puddles; the water shines.

lines.zh: 每一步都比上一步快一点。
lines.en: Each step is a little faster than the last.
I stand and let the rain soak me.
I hear thunder rolling far away.
I plant the trident in the mud.
I chew a piece of rotten flesh.
One of my finger bones clicked.
Light is moving inside the clouds.
I do not breathe, and I do not need to.
I look up and wait for the next flash.
The rain has softened the rotten flesh.
I count the thunder: one, then two.
You do not smell of lightning.

lines.zh: 我盯住你，眼睛一次都没眨。
lines.en: I hold you in sight without one blink.
You stand too straight for this weather.

lines.zh: 我等着你先迈出那一步。
lines.en: I wait for you to take the first step.

lines.zh: 你的影子被闪电照亮了。
lines.en: Lightning lit up your shadow.
You fear thunder; I can tell.
I tilt my head a little.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西是铁的吗。
lines.en: Is that iron in your hand?
The light in my eyes is borrowed.
You came closer, and the rain got heavier.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我骨头上，很响。
lines.en: That landed on bone and rang out.
I do not dodge; it would not help.

lines.zh: 我的一条胳膊从肘上断开。
lines.en: One of my arms broke off at the elbow.

lines.zh: 雨把我的伤口冲干净了。
lines.en: The rain washed my wound clean.
I stagger half a step and steady again.
Pain is a strange thing to me.
Bone dust falls into the mud.
You can actually move me; good.
I push the broken bone back in.
This body should have fallen apart long ago.
You hold out food, and I do not need it.

lines.zh: 我吃腐肉，不吃你手里的。
lines.en: I eat rotten flesh, not what you hold.
Take the food back; I will not touch it.

lines.zh: 我饿，但我不会为你弯腰。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I will not bow for you.
That meat is far too fresh.
I sniff it once and walk away.
Food means little to me.
I want lightning, not bread.
Your arm must be tired by now.
I take nothing from the living.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞一棵湿树。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a wet tree.
I did not move; you fell back two steps.
My shoulder bone is hard to lean on.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，有股焦味。
lines.en: We collided, and there was a smell of burning.

lines.zh: 你身上的雨水溅到我脸上。
lines.en: Your rainwater splashed onto my face.
I push you off, and gently.

lines.zh: 靠近我的人，容易被雷找上。
lines.en: Those who stand near me attract lightning.
You slipped as you backed away.
My trident lies between us.
At that bump, your bones made a sound.
In this state, I do not deserve a mate.
The thunder only keeps me company a while.
I cannot remember who I was.
The living do not come near me.
My bed is wet mud.
I touch my chest; there is nothing there.
A home needs tomorrow, and I have none.
I stand in the rain, alone.
Someone once called my name.
I swallowed those words back down.
I pick up a bone and keep it.
I will not put the trident down.
There is rotten flesh on the ground; I take it.

lines.zh: 我抓东西的时候手会抖。
lines.en: My hands shake when I grab something.
This scrap of iron may be useful.
I only take what belonged to the dead.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时，背上响了一片。
lines.en: When I bend, my whole back crackles.
You dropped it; I toss it back.
I cannot lift anything too heavy.
It has gone soft in the rain.
There is thunder in the clouds; I hear it.
You carry iron, and lightning loves iron.

lines.zh: 那边有个东西在雨里跑。
lines.en: Something is running in the rain over there.

lines.zh: 我要把那具僵尸拉过来。
lines.en: I want to pull that zombie over here.
The storm is here; it is time to work.

lines.zh: 我看见远处有闪电落下。
lines.en: I see lightning strike in the distance.

lines.zh: 你的心跳声在这儿都听得见。
lines.en: I can hear your heartbeat from right here.
Someone holds a torch out in the rain.

lines.zh: 那道光指着地面，是给我的。
lines.en: That bolt points at the ground; it is for me.

lines.zh: 活人的气味从那边飘过来。
lines.en: A living scent drifts over from that side.

lines.zh: 我把三叉戟从泥里拔出来。
lines.en: I pull the trident up out of the mud.

lines.zh: 它还在动，那就还没死透。
lines.en: It is still moving, so it is not finished.

lines.zh: 雷声一响，我就知道方向。
lines.en: When thunder sounds, I know the direction.
This rain came for me.

lines.zh: 雷云压过来的时候，我先动。
lines.en: When the storm cloud lowers, I move first.
I raise the trident and point it at you.
Rainwater drips off the blade.
I need not run; the lightning catches up.
You back under a tree; that is the worst place.
I wait until you stand in water.

lines.zh: 我的影子在闪电里拉长了。
lines.en: My shadow stretched long in the flash.
You count thunder; I count steps.
Three steps from you is close enough.
I lower the blade and aim at your chest.
Did you hear my bones rattle?
The bolt has not fallen; I am patient.

lines.zh: 你每一步都踩在我的影子里。
lines.en: Every step you take lands in my shadow.

lines.zh: 我在雨里站着，像根铁钉。
lines.en: I stand in the rain like an iron nail.

lines.zh: 你抬头看天，那一下就够。
lines.en: You looked up at the sky; that was enough.

lines.zh: 我把戟尖对准你的影子。
lines.en: I level my trident at your shadow.
You stand in a puddle. Convenient.
I count the thunder to the second peal.
I stand on your way out.

lines.zh: 三叉戟捅进去，雷顺着杆来。
lines.en: The trident goes in and lightning follows the shaft.

lines.zh: 这一击，你身上开始带电。
lines.en: After this strike, you carry a charge.
Where I strike, lightning will be drawn.
The cloud behind you lit up.
I sweep your legs out with the shaft.
The thunder is right behind me.
You are knocked back into a tree.
My finger bones rake across your face.
This blow is light, but it calls the bolt.
I hear the lightning looking for me.
The iron on you is humming.
I raise my hand, and the sky answers.
The rain makes this blow land heavier.
I step back and give the spot to lightning.

lines.zh: 戟刃横过去，划开你的肩。
lines.en: The trident sweeps and opens your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我一拳把你打进泥水里。
lines.en: One punch knocks you into the mud.
I only come when the storm comes.

lines.zh: 云压到树顶，我就在下面。
lines.en: Clouds sank to the treetops, and I stood below.

lines.zh: 闪电劈在地上，我站了起来。
lines.en: Lightning struck the ground, and I stood up.
I climb out of the scorched earth.

lines.zh: 沙地、恶地、雪原，我都不去。
lines.en: Deserts, badlands, snowy plains; none for me.
My kind is rarely seen in these parts.

lines.zh: 雨落在我的骨头上，冒烟。
lines.en: Rain hits my bones and smokes.

lines.zh: 我手里已经握着三叉戟。
lines.en: A trident is already in my hand.
Thunder is the name I answer to.
I stand in the rain and wait to be claimed.
That one bolt chose me.
When I opened my eyes, everything was wet.

lines.zh: 我从土里带出一股焦味。
lines.en: I brought a burnt smell up out of the earth.

lines.zh: 别站在我旁边，雷会认错。
lines.en: Do not stand by me; the bolt may err.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的骨头，出了油。
lines.en: Fire crackles on my bones and draws grease.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下去，摔散了。
lines.en: I fell from a height and came apart.

lines.zh: 水灌满我的胸腔，我下沉。
lines.en: Water fills my chest, and I sink.
The blast blew me into two pieces.
An arrow is wedged between my ribs.

lines.zh: 那道光想把我从这具身体里赶出去。
lines.en: That light wants to drive me out of this body.
No rotten flesh, and no lightning either.

lines.zh: 这一下打中我，伤口合上了。
lines.en: That bolt hit me, and my wound closed.
I fall into the dark and the thunder stops.
